title: a`b: package ab has no package comment
body: Package without a package comment. - `a'b/x.go:1` Add a comment directly above the package clause that starts with "Package ab" (https://go.dev/doc/comment).

title: a`b: Bad has no doc comment
body: Undocumented exported function `Bad`. - `a'b/x.go:3` Add a comment directly above the declaration that starts with its name (https://go.dev/doc/comment); for a const/var block, a comment on the block documents every name in it.
